intro.title: Our methodology, piece by piece.
intro.lead: This page walks through our 360° feedback methodology from start to finish, module by module and with the real product screens. It starts at the org chart and the role catalog, which define who gives feedback to whom, goes through the rubric built from a curated question bank, guided by the AI, and ends at the Chilean labor regulation everything is aligned to.

estructura.runningHead: Org chart · Role catalog · AI match
estructura.title: Every role in the company, modeled properly.
estructura.lead: Not only managers: executives, middle management, operations and sales teams, administrative staff and the board. A role catalog with complete coverage, each role with a name, aliases, gender variants and reporting and evaluation relationships: that is how who gives feedback to whom gets defined.

blocks.label: Role catalog
blocks.title: Complete coverage, with the right names.
blocks.body: Each catalog role has a code, a family, aliases, names in Chilean Spanish and English, and gender variants. It declares who it reports to and whom it evaluates. It also includes support roles: general services, receptionist, risk-prevention officer, analysts and account executives. It exports and imports as JSON and is applied to a company.

pauta.title: From the curated bank to a complete rubric for every role.
pauta.lead: The bank is curated: questions written by psychologists and evaluation experts, aligned to Chilean regulation. Each one declares its area, its dimension, which 360° perspectives can answer it, its priority, its weight and the law behind it. The methodology defines how questions are selected — by dimension, perspective, priority and regulation — and the AI guides that assembly up to the role's complete rubric, the basis of the feedback each collaborator receives; you review it before using it.

proceso.title: Real 360° feedback, with a six-stage flow.
proceso.lead: The company defines the weightings. Stages are configured centrally for every company in a group, and each company can adjust them.

weights.label: How much does each perspective weigh?
weights.sub: They define the final calculation. They must add up to exactly 100.

stages.label: Process stages

items.name: In Feedback
items.desc: The evaluator sends the evaluation to the evaluee for feedback

items.name: Finalized
items.desc: Evaluation finalized; its results count in reports

items.name: Closed
items.desc: Definitive closure; only an administrator can reopen it

stages.central: Central configuration: defines which stages of the flow are available by default for every company in the group, by perspective type. Each company can override this configuration on its own stages page.
stages.freeze: Changes apply to new processes: each process freezes its flow when generated, so historical processes keep the configuration they were created with.

resultados.title: Achievement per domain, and what to improve.
resultados.lead: Each evaluation is answered on a 1-to-5 Likert scale. Achievement is calculated per domain according to its weighting, and each domain receives an improvement suggestion for the collaborator being evaluated. Finalized evaluations count in reports.

sugerencia.label: Improvement suggestion · per domain
sugerencia.text: After answering, each domain receives an improvement suggestion written from the answers. It is a starting point for the feedback conversation with each collaborator, not a verdict.

ia.title: The AI guides. The company decides.
ia.lead: Eleva automated the process and built the methodology; the AI helps your team follow it at three concrete points of the system and unblocks whatever gets stuck. In all three, the last word is yours.

rows.name: Role match
rows.proposes: For each unassigned role in your org chart, it recommends catalog templates with a confidence percentage and explains its reasoning: "Name and description identical to AN_OPS. Child of the Head of Operations, consistent as direct support for the area's daily management." If the tree does not fit, it proposes how to improve it.
rows.decides: You pick an option with "Choose", or describe what is missing or what you are looking for and receive a new proposal.

rows.name: Guided rubric
rows.proposes: It guides the assembly of the role's rubric from the curated question bank, applying the methodology: selection by dimension, perspective, priority and regulation. The result is the role's complete rubric, with its dimensions and the regulations and frameworks it evaluates.
rows.decides: You review the rubric, grouped by framework and area, before using it in a process.

rows.name: Improvement suggestion
rows.proposes: After answering, it proposes one improvement suggestion per domain for each collaborator.
rows.decides: Feedback stays between people: the suggestion is a starting point, not a result.

ia.quoteStart: The AI will propose the best solution;
ia.never: The AI does not evaluate, does not decide results and does not write regulation.

normativa.runningHead: Every question, traced to the law
normativa.title: Every question, traced to Chilean labor regulation.
normativa.lead: Each role's rubric lists the national regulation and frameworks it aligns with; the General Manager rubric and the Operations Analyst rubric do not cite the same laws. Each question carries its laws as tags: Labor Code, Ley Karin, Non-Discrimination, Personal Data Protection 2024, Work Accidents. The result is consistent, defensible evaluations.
